title: CCIP ME
tagline: A simple cross chain dapp built using chainlink CCIP to mint nft from one chain to other.
description:
A simple cross chain dapp built using chainlink CCIP to mint nft from one chain to other without having to switch chains and dont have to pay gas in destination chain currrency.

The user will be able to connect wallet to polygon mumbai using wallet connect and mint the nft on Avalanche chain without switching chains or paying fees in avax.
how_its_made:
Smart contract: solidity, chainlink, openzepplin, hardhat
front end: React, javascript, html, css
backend: javascript, node

sponsor technologies used:
Wallet Connect - helped connecting different wallet like metamask, rainbow wallet
Chainlink CCIP - able to cross mint nft on different blockchain
